focus_areas: Boundary integrity between the heel rest and soleplate (using BBox-guided segmentation).
Optical clarity and internal structure of the water reservoir.
Geometric consistency of the handle and body connection.
Inference of occluded features via fine-grained model identification.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the interface between the grey plastic heel rest and the metal soleplate. Use the bounding boxes provided by the open_vocabulary_detector to guide the topology_boundary_auditor in checking for 'melting' or ambiguous boundaries. Also, scrutinize the blue translucent window; ensure the internal details (or lack thereof) are optically consistent with a hollow plastic container. Finally, leverage the fine_grained_classifier's output: if it identifies a specific real-world iron model, use that knowledge to infer the likely presence/position of the occluded dials and steam holes, rather than marking them purely as missing.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a modern steam iron standing vertically on its heel rest. The iron features a white and blue plastic body with a metallic soleplate visible at the bottom. It is resting on a wrinkled white fabric surface, likely an ironing board cover or sheet.
